title: News 2
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Pool swept twice before any word was written (make_pool.py --before leaf_news_b2). First sweep dropped 8 already taught: source, poverty, unemployment, strike, deny, resign, resignation, budget. b1_news already owns the core newsroom and civics set (headline, broadcast, editor, coverage, scandal, government, election, politician, vote, debate, poll, protest, minister, crisis, economy, tax, campaign, reform) and b2_media owns the industry side (press, tabloid, outlet, newsroom, clickbait, viral) — this unit is deliberately the third layer: how news is judged for truth, how power is held to account, and the society words the headlines actually use. C57 card 0 recaps News 1. C49 all 36 words shown across three boards of 12. Build-the-family card: bias -> biased, censor -> censorship, corrupt -> corruption, controversy -> controversial, all four derived forms drilled as bank items. A12 senses on policy (government) — not an insurance policy — and demonstration (protest) — not a product demo. Bands 12 B2 / 13 C1 / 1 B1 / 10 unbanded. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: News 1 gave you the newsroom and the machinery of public life — headline, broadcast, editor, coverage, government, election, politician, vote, debate, minister, economy, tax. Those words come back in this unit's sentences. What is new here is the layer above them: whether a story is true, whether power is being watched, and the words the headlines use for what is happening to people.
cards.note_cz: News 1 ti dal redakci a mechaniku veřejného života — headline, broadcast, editor, coverage, government, election, politician, vote, debate, minister, economy, tax. Ta slova se vracejí ve větách. Nové je tu to, co je nad nimi: jestli je zpráva pravdivá, jestli někdo hlídá moc, a slova, kterými titulky popisují, co se děje lidem.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Four words in this unit build a second form you also need.

cards.title: You will use these words in

sentences.en: Every newspaper has some bias in its reporting.
sentences.cz: Každé noviny mají ve svém zpravodajství určitou zaujatost.
accepts: Every newspaper has some bias in its reporting

sentences.en: That report was clearly biased against the government.
sentences.cz: Ta zpráva byla jasně zaujatá proti vládě.
accepts: That report was clearly biased against the government

sentences.en: Some countries censor what people can read online.
sentences.cz: Některé země cenzurují, co si lidé můžou číst online.
accepts: Some countries censor what people can read online

sentences.en: Censorship of the press is a problem for journalists.
sentences.cz: Cenzura tisku je problém pro novináře.
accepts: Censorship of the press is a problem for journalists

sentences.en: The government used propaganda during the war.
sentences.cz: Vláda během války používala propagandu.
accepts: The government used propaganda during the war

sentences.en: Misinformation reaches people faster than real news.
sentences.cz: Dezinformace se k lidem dostanou rychleji než skutečné zprávy.
accepts: Misinformation reaches people faster than real news

sentences.en: He calls every story he dislikes fake news.
sentences.cz: Každý článek, který se mu nelíbí, nazývá falešnými zprávami.
accepts: He calls every story he dislikes fake news

sentences.en: A whistleblower told reporters about the missing money.
sentences.cz: Oznamovatel řekl novinářům o chybějících penězích.
accepts: A whistleblower told reporters about the missing money

sentences.en: Our correspondent in Rome sent this report.
sentences.cz: Náš zpravodaj v Římě poslal tuto zprávu.
accepts: Our correspondent in Rome sent this report

sentences.en: The editorial argued for a change in the law.
sentences.cz: Úvodník se zasazoval o změnu zákona.
accepts: The editorial argued for a change in the law

sentences.en: Reporters should fact-check a story before they publish it.
sentences.cz: Novináři by měli ověřit fakta, než článek zveřejní.
accepts: Reporters should fact-check a story before they publish it

sentences.en: Breaking news stopped the film after nine.
sentences.cz: Mimořádné zprávy zastavily film po deváté.
accepts: Breaking news stopped the film after nine

sentences.en: The country held a referendum on the new law.
sentences.cz: Země uspořádala referendum o novém zákoně.
accepts: The country held a referendum on the new law

sentences.en: Turnout at the election was lower than expected.
sentences.cz: Účast ve volbách byla nižší, než se čekalo.
accepts: Turnout at the election was lower than expected

sentences.en: Three parties formed a coalition after the vote.
sentences.cz: Tři strany po volbách vytvořily koalici.
accepts: Three parties formed a coalition after the vote

sentences.en: The opposition criticised the minister for weeks.
sentences.cz: Opozice ministra kritizovala celé týdny.
accepts: The opposition criticised the minister for weeks

sentences.en: The government won a large majority of the votes.
sentences.cz: Vláda získala velkou většinu hlasů.
accepts: The government won a large majority of the votes

sentences.en: Only a small minority supported the new plan.
sentences.cz: Nový plán podpořila jen malá menšina.
accepts: Only a small minority supported the new plan

sentences.en: Their new policy will raise taxes for everyone.
sentences.cz: Jejich nová politika zvýší daně pro všechny.
accepts: Their new policy will raise taxes for everyone

sentences.en: New legislation will change how companies pay tax.
sentences.cz: Nová legislativa změní, jak firmy platí daně.
accepts: New legislation will change how companies pay tax

sentences.en: The judge said the police officers were corrupt.
sentences.cz: Soudce řekl, že ti policisté byli zkorumpovaní.
accepts: The judge said the police officers were corrupt

sentences.en: Corruption in the government caused the protests.
sentences.cz: Korupce ve vládě způsobila ty protesty.
accepts: Corruption in the government caused the protests

sentences.en: People want more transparency from the government.
sentences.cz: Lidé chtějí od vlády větší průhlednost.
accepts: People want more transparency from the government

sentences.en: There is little accountability when things go wrong.
sentences.cz: Když se něco pokazí, je odpovědnost malá.
accepts: There is little accountability when things go wrong

sentences.en: The decision caused controversy across the country.
sentences.cz: To rozhodnutí vyvolalo spor v celé zemi.
accepts: The decision caused controversy across the country

sentences.en: His most controversial book was published last year.
sentences.cz: Jeho nejkontroverznější kniha vyšla loni.
accepts: His most controversial book was published last year

sentences.en: Inequality in this country keeps growing.
sentences.cz: Nerovnost v této zemi stále roste.
accepts: Inequality in this country keeps growing

sentences.en: The welfare system supports families with no work.
sentences.cz: Systém sociální podpory pomáhá rodinám bez práce.
accepts: The welfare system supports families with no work

sentences.en: Inflation has made food much more expensive.
sentences.cz: Inflace hodně zdražila jídlo.
accepts: Inflation has made food much more expensive

sentences.en: The recession cost thousands of people their jobs.
sentences.cz: Recese připravila tisíce lidí o práci.
accepts: The recession cost thousands of people their jobs

sentences.en: A refugee from the war now lives here.
sentences.cz: Uprchlík z té války teď žije tady.
accepts: A refugee from the war now lives here

sentences.en: Months of unrest followed the election result.
sentences.cz: Po výsledku voleb následovaly měsíce nepokojů.
accepts: Months of unrest followed the election result

sentences.en: A riot broke out in the city centre.
sentences.cz: V centru města vypukly výtržnosti.
accepts: A riot broke out in the city centre

sentences.en: Thousands joined the demonstration in the city.
sentences.cz: Tisíce lidí se přidaly k demonstraci ve městě.
accepts: Thousands joined the demonstration in the city

sentences.en: One activist spoke to reporters after the meeting.
sentences.cz: Jeden aktivista po schůzce mluvil s novináři.
accepts: One activist spoke to reporters after the meeting

sentences.en: Customers organised a boycott of the new company.
sentences.cz: Zákazníci zorganizovali bojkot té nové firmy.
accepts: Customers organised a boycott of the new company

use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.
